label: weak k/m-accumulation unit around the end of input / start of copy
explanation: Sparse (about 1% of steps) and diffuse. It never fires at t=0 or 1. Activity clusters at original positions 2-3, at the <DEL> step and at the first copy steps (recall_idx 0-1), plus a small bump at the last copy step of L=9 sequences. The strongest correlate is that k or m appeared earlier as input: prev_tok, prev2_tok and next_out lifts for k/m are 4-5x, and seen(k|m) covers 84% of activations and 89% of activation mass, but at about 3% precision. The top activations (up to 0.30) are at <DEL> or copy step 1 in short or k/m-heavy sequences such as k m m <DEL> and m m m <DEL>. Requiring at least 2 k/m inputs before step t, for 2<=t<=L+1, gives the best dev F1 (0.17, precision 0.12). Precision stays at or below about 0.12 for every simple predicate tried, apart from a narrow high-precision slice: sequences starting with two k/m tokens, at t=2-3 (precision 0.62, recall 0.04). Most steps that follow k/m stay silent, so the unit probably reads a distributed hidden-state direction that simple token predicates cannot capture.
